gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Grandstander is loud and bouncy, with open letterforms and a tall x-height that never curl shut. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed follows in a plain sans, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sintony: Chunky and unmistakably playful, Gugi has tall lowercase and open terminals, and no hairlines to squint at when it shrinks down. Sintony brings the sturdy, smooth sans.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-stack-sa: Loose, handmade and a bit cheeky, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its terminals flaring outward, with a level beat throughout. Stack Sans Headline sits beneath it, monoline and crisp.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sono: Metamorphous has generous sidebearings, a high midline and a gentle swing between fat and slim strokes. Sono takes the body in a sans with wide default spacing, and it can stay modest in size because its tall lowercase carries well.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-archivo: Archivo carries the text with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward rather than curling inward, which gives the sans-serif real presence. Shantell Sans above it has a fixed nib width and a wide mouth, so paragraphs below feel sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-asap: Shantell Sans draws every stroke at one nib width, diagonals included, with a mouth as wide as a cut tin lid. Its job is personality; Asap, a sans-serif with open arcs and a high body height, handles the quiet work of reading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Shantell Sans is hand-drawn and wide-mouthed, with one fixed nib width. It brings the character, while Be Vietnam Pro, a sans-serif with a high mean line and curve endings kept well apart, brings a tidy, steady text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-epilogue: Epilogue sets a tall-bodied lowercase with stubby ascender tips and a wire-like monoline skeleton that feels loose and curvy. And Shantell Sans, with its wide mouth and fixed nib width, adds a wobbly handmade lift above it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-fira-sans: Text in Fira Sans reads large and generous, with s curves opening wide at both ends and no thick-thin contrast at all. Shantell Sans is the one with the wide-mouthed personality, while Fira handles the sustained reading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-merriweather-san: Wobbly meets sturdy here, with Shantell Sans holding one constant stroke from top to baseline. And Merriweather Sans answers with tall lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly, so words look large and solid.
